articles.original_title: Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs?
articles.title_pt: Agentes de código de IA lutam contra APIs não-REST?
articles.excerpt: Should your next API be REST, or something else? And which one will AI coding agents handle best? We tested REST, POST-only and RPC-style APIs with six models across 1,356 runs, and what decided whether agents succeeded had nothing to do with API style. The post Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers .
articles.summary: A Microsoft testou estilos de API REST, POST-only e RPC-style com seis modelos em 1.356 execuções para verificar o comportamento de agentes de código. Os testes indicam que o fator decisivo para o sucesso dos agentes não tem relação com o estilo da API.
articles.why_it_matters: Ajuda desenvolvedores a entenderem as limitação e o comportamento real de agentes de programação ao interagir com diferentes arquiteturas de backend.
key_points: Foram testados estilos de API REST, POST-only e RPC-style.
O estudo envolveu 6 modelos e 1.356 execuções.
O estilo da API não foi o fator determinante para o sucesso dos agentes.
potential_impacts: Pode mudar a forma como arquitetos projetam integrações voltadas para o uso de assistentes de IA.
uncertainties: O trecho não especifica quais foram os seis modelos testados.

articles.excerpt: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. articles.title_pt: TOUMAII: Um Conjunto de Dados de Preferência de Chamada de Ferramentas de 4,5 Milhões de Pares e Seu Gerador Agnóstico de Fonte

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. articles.excerpt: Federated fine-tuning of foundation models with low-rank adapters (LoRA) is typically reconciled by averaging locally trained adapters. In cross-device settings, where participants hold heterogeneous data and join or leave asynchronously, averaging is poorly suited: locally trained adapters are not identifiable up to permutation, and averages of adapters trained on dissimilar data can be uninformative or unstable. articles.original_title: NitroGen: Observations on the Action Dynamics, Visual Instruction Following, and Spatial Exploration
articles.title_pt: NitroGen: observações sobre a dinâmica de ação, o cumprimento de instruções visuais e a exploração espacial
articles.excerpt: NitroGen is an open vision-action foundation model for game control. It is trained by behavior cloning on online gameplay videos. In this paper, we study the frozen controller in Hollow Knight and Trackmania as examples along three dimensions: action adaptation, visual instruction following, and spatial exploration. Our results indicate that NitroGen can adapt its actions to local context, but it lacks the planning, recovery, and exploration needed for longer-horizon game control.
